label: Jeiel

text.BHSA 2CH 29:12: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ הַ֠לְוִיִּם מַ֣חַת בֶּן־עֲמָשַׂ֞י וְיֹואֵ֣ל בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָהוּ֮ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י הַקְּהָתִי֒ וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י קִ֚ישׁ בֶּן־עַבְדִּ֔י וַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־יְהַלֶּלְאֵ֑ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י יֹואָח֙ בֶּן־זִמָּ֔ה וְעֵ֖דֶן בֶּן־יֹואָֽח׃
text.KJV 2CH 29:12: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
text.BHSA 2CH 29:13: וּמִן־בְּנֵי֙ אֱלִ֣יצָפָ֔ן שִׁמְרִ֖י ויעואל וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ וּמַתַּנְיָֽהוּ׃ ס
text.KJV 2CH 29:13: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
text.BHSA 2CH 29:14: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֥י הֵימָ֖ן יחואל וְשִׁמְעִ֑י ס וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י יְדוּת֔וּן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֖ה וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
text.KJV 2CH 29:14: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

A.name: Jeiel
A.notes: Kohathites (from Uzziel, from Kohath, son of Levi)

B.name: Jeiel
B.line: Gershonite Levite of the sons of Elizaphan, listed with Shimri.

why: The Hebrew lists Jeiel with Shimri among the sons of Elizaphan, separately from the Gershonites in verse 12. The stated Elizaphan–Uzziel–Kohath lineage fits A and conflicts with B’s description as a Gershonite.
